**GAIA**

*GAIA* is a POS (Point-of-Sale) system integrated with an algorithm to identify and evaluate system latency and desynchronization. The system is web-based and will be implemented in a local host. The POS system will have the following features:

- [x] User-friendly dashboard for easy integration from common POS systems
- [x] Localized Web Application to reduce Online Security Issues
